title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17
source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > Soundtrack Pro > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging)

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording captures a high‑energy late‑summer 1982 show with tight song transitions and incredible overall sound.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised as a standout example of the Dead’s late‑summer 1982 tour, featuring a twelve‑song first set that rocks out of the gate with seamless segues (Bertha → Promised Land, Candyman → C.C. Rider, etc.). Reviewers note the tape sounds “incredible” and describe the recording as great, indicating a clear, well‑balanced matrix source. Overall the performance is high‑energy and the sound quality makes it highly listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviews are enthusiastic about both the musical performance and the recording; no complaints were noted, yielding a high rating despite only three reviews.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the overall sound as incredible with no reported drop‑outs or muddiness; mix is clear and well balanced.

standout_songs: Dupree's Diamond Blues > Used to Love Her
show_quality.setlist_flow: Set One consists of 12 tightly arranged tunes with strong segues that keep the momentum high throughout.
